task: replicate the OSD-314 partial-gravity result in an independent study

provenance.rawNote: 73 MB of per-sample RSEM quantifications are not committed; their SHA-256 digests are, so the committed matrices rebuild byte-identically.
provenance.expression: log2(TPM + 1), genes detected in at least half the libraries

design.noFlightConfound: Every library is a flight sample, so the whole 0-1 g series is comparable in orbit. OSD-314 could not do this: its 1 g samples were ground controls.
design.whyThatMatters: Holding out a light treatment removes no gravity level, so the split tests generalization rather than interpolation between missing levels.

P1_binaryReplication.scheme: phyA, 0 g versus 0.25-0.38 g, train on one light treatment and test on the other

permutation.degenerateMeaning: Every permutation returns the same score, which happens when the model predicts a single class: the null is a point mass and this p-value carries no information. It must not be read as 'no effect'.

P1_binaryReplication.powerNote: ten libraries over two folds. A binary classifier on 100 selected genes has very little room here, so a failure to replicate is underpowered evidence, not proof that the OSD-314 signal is absent.

P1b_lowestPartial.scheme: phyA, 0 g versus 0.1 g, held-out light treatment

P1c_widerContrast.scheme: phyA, 0 g versus 0.1-0.38 g (all partial levels), held-out light treatment

P2_gradedRegression.scheme: phyA, ridge on real g across six commanded levels 0-1 g, held-out light treatment

P3_crossGenotype.scheme: train on phyA (0 g versus 0.1-0.5 g), test on phyB, no phyB rows seen in training

decisionRule: The OSD-314 result replicates only if the 0 g versus partial contrast exceeds 0.5 balanced accuracy on an unseen light treatment with a design-preserving permutation p below 0.05. Graded recoverability requires a positive Spearman correlation with p below 0.05. Fixed before the run.
notPromotedBecause: 36 libraries across two genotypes and two light treatments
commanded and realised gravity differ (centrifugation), so the label is a measured level, not a set point
the genotypes are phytochrome mutants, so this is not wild-type physiology
a servable predictor needs replication across missions, not two light treatments inside one
